ev.q: The games featured in this collection are by far the best FPS genre video games ever developed
Most weapons are sci-fi and their mechanics are unique in itself
Story has surprisingly so much depth, unlike generic war campaigns
the music still gives me goosebumps
They are easily the best part of the game for me
With more than 120 multiplayer maps and countless ways to play
325 hours of finishing the fight, over and over again
